title: InstantFusion: A Shared Latent Interface for Heterogeneous Image Generators
title_zh: InstantFusion：一种用于异构图像生成器的共享潜在接口

paragraphs.en: InstantFusion 是一种轻量级的共享潜在接口，用于连接不同架构的图像生成器。 Diffusion/flow models have emerged as the de facto paradigms for image generation, giving rise to a diverse family of modern generators with increasingly heterogeneous architectures and representations. Despite their remarkable generation capabilities, the cross-model alignment of latent representations and the consistency of their underlying denoising dynamics remain underexplored. In this work, we uncover an intriguing cross-model compatibility: independently trained generators exhibit similar latent spatial organization, while directly handing off intermediate states between unaligned models can still preserve coarse visual content. Motivated by these observations, we propose InstantFusion, a lightweight shared latent interface that connects the denoising trajectories of heterogeneous image generators. Specifically, to enable flexible cross-model state translation, model-specific Latent AutoEncoders (LAEs) are introduced to project intermediate states from different generators into a shared latent space and decode them into the latent space of a target generator. This shared space is constrained by two complementary objectives: aligning intermediate states derived from the same image at matched noise levels and synchronizing their corresponding local denoising velocities. Once trained, InstantFusion allows denoising to seamlessly transition across frozen generators without requiring a dedicated mapping for every model pair. The versatility of InstantFusion is demonstrated across acceleration, multi-preference composition, cross-architecture on-policy distillation, and cross-model composition, achieving competitive performance across these diverse settings.
paragraphs.zh: InstantFusion 是一种轻量级的共享潜在接口，用于连接不同架构的图像生成器。扩散/流模型已成为图像生成的事实标准范式，催生了众多现代生成器，这些生成器的架构和表示形式日益多样化且异质化。 尽管它们具有出色的生成能力，但潜在表示的跨模型对齐及其底层去噪动态的一致性仍未被充分研究。 在本项工作中，我们发现了一种有趣的跨模型兼容性：独立训练的生成器展现出相似的潜在空间组织方式，而直接在未对齐的模型之间传递中间状态，仍能保留粗略的视觉内容。 基于这些观察，我们提出了 InstantFusion——一种轻量级的共享潜在接口，能够连接异质图像生成器的去噪轨迹。 具体而言，为了实现灵活的跨模型状态转换，我们引入了模型特定的潜在自编码器（LAE），将不同生成器的中间状态投影到共享潜在空间中，并解码为目标生成器的潜在空间表示。 该共享空间由两个互补的目标约束：在匹配噪声水平下对齐源自同一图像的中间状态，并同步其对应的局部去噪速度。 训练完成后，InstantFusion 使去噪过程能够在冻结的生成器之间无缝切换，而无需为每对模型单独建立映射。 我们在加速、多偏好合成、跨架构在线策略蒸馏以及跨模型合成等多个场景中验证了 InstantFusion 的通用性，并在这些多样化设置中实现了具有竞争力的性能。
